data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6117 reported an opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 144.4m at 1 January 2023. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a modest favourable prioryear development of approximately GBP 2.5m (a c.1.7% release versus opening reserves), driven by good claims experience on longertail and Specialty classes. The managing agent notes improvement in prior year reserves for 2022 and 2021. The book is predominantly reinsurance acceptances (treaty) and catastrophe exposure was limited by narrowed risk appetite and increased retentions, with RITC activity noted in the technical provisions which may influence comparability of vintage movements.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) gross figure not explicitly stated in a dedicated 'movement in prior year's provision' gross column. PYD derived from the gross claims development table (triangle) comparing the 2021 current estimate to its previous diagonal, excluding the two most recent years (2023, 2022). An External RITC line appears in Technical Provisions (impact shown as (61.6)m) which can distort movements and comparability; results should be interpreted accordingly. Where narrative refers to 'improvement' this is consistent with the triangle-derived small release. Confidence downgraded from 1.0 to 0.8 for the PYD as it is a calculated value from the triangle and only a single older underwriting year contributed.
